nos.titulo: Umbral was born from an impossible move
nos.p1: We were looking for a home in a city we didn't know: misleading photos, incomplete data and processes that seemed designed to wear anyone down.
nos.p2: That's why we built Umbral: a portal where every property is verified, every profile validated and every step accompanied. A true threshold between you and your new beginning.
nos.mision.d: Make finding a home in Colombia as memorable as living in it: transparent, verified and human.
nos.vision.d: To be the trusted threshold through which Colombia buys, rents and sells property by 2030.
porque.sub: Every listing goes through human verification and AI validation before being published.

porque.2.d: Validates your documents and answers your questions at any hour, every day.
porque.3.d: Sign online with full legal validity and track your process in real time.
porque.4.d: From Bogotá to Cartagena: national coverage with experts in every region.
